title: Bullying Incident Checklist
subtitle: Capture reported conduct, exact statement, location pattern, and protective step; confirm retaliation concern and support follow-up.
description: Bullying Incident records reported conduct, exact statement, location pattern, protective step, retaliation concern, and support follow-up. Bullying Incident evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this bullying incident stage-gated verification when staff must document reported conduct and exact statement. Reconcile location pattern, protective step, retaliation concern, and support follow-up before the bullying incident handoff. Preserve the original report, dated witness accounts, location map or digital-channel reference, protective-action log, retaliation check, and restricted support record. Ask the assigned bullying incident reviewer to confirm reported conduct against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Bullying Incident starting details
sections.guidance: Separate reported conduct and exact statements from observations; record location patterns, protective measures, retaliation concerns, and support follow-up.

sections.title: Bullying Incident checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current bullying incident facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Bullying Incident required checks
items: Reported conduct is identified for this record
Exact statement matches the current request or source
Location pattern is ready for point-of-use staff
Protective step limits or questions are resolved
Retaliation concern is communicated to the responsible person
Support follow-up is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Bullying Incident failed or pending items

sections.title: Bullying Incident exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold bullying incident readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Bullying Incident reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Bullying Incident receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
